fact: NewsDay reports the government unveiled a national cybersecurity strategy at a Harare conference on Wednesday 15 October 2025, the ICT minister saying its development was completed; the period is not stated.

MISA Zimbabwe states that a Cybersecurity and Monitoring Centre operates under the Office of the President with no judicial oversight; the document gives no date for its creation and is dated 2026-06-23, which is used as as_of.

fact: POTRAZ's acting CIRT and enforcement manager says POTRAZ established a Computer Incident Response Team to identify, manage and respond to computer security incidents in the country.

POTRAZ's Computer Incident Response Team, described as the national hub for detecting and coordinating responses to cyber incidents, handled incident reports in 2025, broken down as fraud 33%, cyberbullying 27%, hacking 17%, smishing 13% and theft 10%, per its Data Protection Officer.

The Herald reports a POTRAZ Deputy Director for the Computer Incident Response Team (CIRT) and Enforcement, Evidence Mazhindu, presenting for the regulator, so a CIRT exists inside the telecom regulator.
ICT Minister Tatenda Mavetera cited the implementation of the Cybersecurity Strategy among the sector's key policy frameworks.
